dataset_split.policy: Scene-disjoint 32/4/4 split. Every one of the 32 views of a physical scene stays in one split, preventing layout leakage. The eight held-out scenes are stratified so both validation and test independently contain all 11 object IDs.

stable_pose_scene_generation.source: Adapter v3: randomly choose six distinct objects from an 11-object pool for every candidate, then use analytic Trimesh stable poses and the latest random-anchor uniform/compact/spread footprint packer. Isaac Sim 5.0 performs the final stability acceptance.

network_training.training_policy: Train the Wuji2 20-joint model from random initialization for 20000 iterations with four CPU data-loader workers, select checkpoints using four scene-disjoint validation scenes, and report the final result only on four untouched test scenes.

simulation_execution.squeeze_semantics: Each fingertip target moves 0.03 m along its configured inward direction; full 20-joint IK is used instead of distal-joint-only closure.
simulation_execution.self_collision_policy: Reject or flag waypoints with finger-to-finger link penetration before GUI execution, and enable Isaac contact diagnostics during execution.
